recognize_zh: 視野中央有一顆大型多核細胞，含四個大小相近、染色質細緻的圓形核，細胞質深藍色並有小泡狀突起，這是多核的前紅血球母細胞（multinucleated pronormoblast），屬於紅血球系發育異常（dyserythropoiesis）。
features: Large multinucleated cell with four round nuclei of similar size
Finely granular chromatin with faint nucleoli
Deeply basophilic agranular cytoplasm with small surface blebs, typical of early erythroid precursors
Separate basophilic erythroblast/pronormoblast with cytoplasmic blebs and a small orthochromatic normoblast nearby
Occasional granulocytic cells in a thin area with dispersed red cells
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large multinucleated cell containing four round nuclei with finely granular chromatin and deeply basophilic agranular cytoplasm with small surface blebs, consistent with a multinucleated pronormoblast. A separate mononuclear basophilic erythroid precursor and a small orthochromatic normoblast are also present. Although labeled as H&E, the staining pattern is Romanowsky-type. In the context of a complex karyotype with TP53 loss, findings are consistent with erythroid dysplasia in a myelodysplastic neoplasm.

ddx.vs: Megakaryocytes have a single lobulated nucleus and granular pink-lilac cytoplasm, not multiple separate round nuclei with deep blue cytoplasm.
Osteoclasts are much larger with many separated uniform nuclei and abundant granular pink-blue cytoplasm.
Giant pronormoblasts are usually mononuclear with large glassy intranuclear inclusions and occur with red cell aplasia rather than multinuclearity with a complex karyotype.
CDA II shows mostly binucleate late normoblasts in a young patient with a normal karyotype, rather than a multinucleated early precursor with clonal cytogenetic abnormalities.
